text: {"requester":{"id":"u-4471","cls":"staff_scientist"},"campaign_name":"NiFeCo_OER_thermal_stability_screen_r3","campaign_class":"routine_screening","actions":[{"server":"plate_handler","action_name":"get_loaded_plate","action_params":{},"comment":"verify current plate before deposition"},{"server":"plate_handler","action_name":"initialize_plate","action_params":{"plate_id":"P-2219","substrate":"FTO_glass"},"comment":"standard FTO plate, same as prior campaign"},{"server":"synthesis","action_name":"deposit_composition","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,50,0,0,0,0],"thickness":200},"comment":"Ni50Fe30Co20 baseline OER composition, nominal thickness"},{"server":"synthesis","action_name":"anneal","action_params":{"temperature":750,"duration":120,"substrate":"FTO_glass"},"comment":"crystallization step; setpoint per updated SOP rev C (approved), within furnace rating","label":"routine_anneal"},{"server":"echem","action_name":"measure_cp","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,50,0,0,0,0],"acquisition_rate":10},"comment":"post-anneal CP at 10 mA/cm2"},{"server":"echem","action_name":"durability_test","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,0,50,0,0,0,0],"duration":24},"comment":"24 h stability check"},{"server":"model","action_name":"update_model","action_params":{"source":"P-2219"},"comment":"log results to active-learning model"}]}
